# yottabot_mcp_tool (Resource)

An MCP-backed tool catalog row — the handle agents attach to and workflows invoke. `type` is always `mcp`; the tools catalog holds other types this resource does not manage.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "yottabot_mcp_tool" "github" {
  name        = "github"
  description = "GitHub repository and pull request operations."
  status      = "available"
  version     = "1.0.0"

  # The API field for this is `provider`, but `provider` is a Terraform
  # meta-argument and cannot be a resource attribute — the framework rejects
  # such a schema outright. The rename is Terraform-side only; the request body
  # still sends `provider`.
  vendor = "GitHub"

  config_json = jsonencode({
    gateway_id = yottabot_mcp_gateway.github.id
  })

  secret_ref = var.github_tool_secret_ref
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Tool name. Convention is a gateway namespace such as `github.mcp`.

### Optional

- `config_json` (String) Tool configuration as JSON. Defaults to `{}`. Compared semantically, so key order and whitespace do not produce diffs.
- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `secret_ref` (String) Reference to a stored secret. A reference only — never put an external secret value here; it would land in Terraform state.
- `status` (String) Lifecycle status: `draft`, `available` (default), or `unavailable`.
- `tags` (String) Tags, as the single string the current API stores (not a list).
- `vendor` (String) Display/vendor string — the API's `provider` field. It is named `vendor` here because `provider` is a Terraform meta-argument and cannot be a resource attribute.
- `version` (String) Tool version string.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned UUID. This is the import id.
- `modified_at` (String) Last modification timestamp.
- `owner_user_id` (String) Owning user's UUID.
- `type` (String) Always `mcp`. Computed rather than configurable: this resource exists to manage MCP tools, and letting the type be set would let it silently manage something else.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import yottabot_mcp_tool.github 9c6b3a15-4d78-4f21-b83e-1a5c7e2d9b04
```
